The change I made was to fix the `pageCount` function in `src/paginate.js` to correctly handle partial pages by using `Math.ceil` instead of `Math.floor`. This ensures that when there are leftover items that don't fill a complete page, they are counted as an additional page.

The fix is minimal and exactly addresses the problem described:
- Before: `pageCount(25, 10)` returned `2` (incorrectly dropping the partial page)
- After: `pageCount(25, 10)` returns `3` (correctly counting the partial page)

All tests pass, confirming that the implementation now correctly handles:
- Zero items → 0 pages
- Exact multiples → correct page count
- Partial pages → counted as full pages
- Error conditions → still properly throw RangeError

This is the smallest possible change that fixes the issue while maintaining all existing functionality.
